hyperedges.label: Modpack lifecycle pipeline: Discovery → Orchestration → Requirements → Conflicts → Build/Crash → Quests → Updates → Packaging
Statically-detectable conflicts (one-step-ahead wins): duplicate modId, version mismatch, declared incompatibility, side mismatch detected from metadata by the conflicts module
RequirementsReport inputs: Java-by-MC-version rule + RAM/heaviness heuristics + category weights feed the requirements module
The nine constitution principles form the supreme SDD gate
The six accepted ADRs constitute the project's durable decision memory
Roadmap phases 0-3 form the implemented build pipeline (foundation→discovery→orchestration→conflict pre-flight)
Discovery capability: spec → plan → tasks chain
Requirements prediction: spec → plan → tasks chain
Lifecycle data pipeline: brief → resolved set → requirements → build
Modrinth Provider capability: port + adapter + mappers + contract/transport tests
Pack State capability: PackState types + PackFormat port + packwiz adapter + round-trip tests
Mod Orchestration capability: resolver + dep BFS + categorization + PackState pinning + recommendation + CLI
Four SDD authoring templates form the authoring kit
Spec 0007 spec→plan→tasks SDD chain
Spec 0008 spec→plan→tasks SDD chain
